# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 11 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Cain and Abel Born; Abel Killed

---

**1** Adam knew his wife Eve and she conceived and bore Abel. Cain and Abel grew up together.

**2** Abel became a keeper of sheep, and Cain became a tiller of the ground.

**3** In the course of time Cain brought an offering to the Lord from the fruit of the ground, and Abel brought from the firstlings of his flock and their fat portions.

**4** The Lord regarded Abel and his offering with favor, but Cain and his offering he did not regard.

**5** Cain was very angry and his countenance fell. And Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him in the field.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
